column3: I have earned my freedom.

Let's ride!

VICTORY OR DEATH!
DO NOT GIVE AN INCH OF GROUND!

No!

and to build new traditions that honor our proud legacy.

or to think you could have stopped what happened, if you had just seen what was right in front of you.

This is not over.

Strength and Unity.

Rescue who you can along the way.

We will be back, and we will be ready.
We have to regroup.
Has anyone seen Cadgar?
Jaina and I will rally the Alliance and the Horn.

Reach out through the storm, Luvsella, as we discussed!
Good. Open your mind and your heart to them.
Go to her, champion. Lend her your strength.
Just like we practice, Lufcilla. The storm is your ally.
Well done. The storm has granted the rooks its strength.
An ancient stormrider outpost. Meet us there, champion.
LOTAR, EVERYONE!
The Rooks have chosen their riders. A true bond has been forged.
The Stormrooks and their new riders need time, and you are needed at the shore, champion.
Is this all that remains of the Stormriders?
These Stormriders will heal in time, but what about the Stormrooks?
Your bond with Shubendre is strong, Luvsella. You may be key to summoning more Stormrooks.
Not quite, old friend. Times have changed. The line between friend and foe is not so clear.
Wait, Ful'jin. Horde is spilling Horde blood. It's tearing me apart.
I know. I trust you to lead the siege. I am needed elsewhere.
I refuse to believe that all of my brethren support Garrosh.

It has to be said Vol'jin. If we don't make it through this, I want you to know you have always been my friend, my brother.
For the Horde.
It is not too late, Garrosh. Lay down the mantle of Warchief. We can end this here, now, with no more bloodshed.
Then you have forced my hand. I will correct the mistake I made long ago. Spirits of the wind, the earth, the water, hear my call! Come to my aid!"
Never powerless, Garrosh, and never alone.
I will forestall any counter-attacks by the enemy. Lok Tarogar!
Stand back.
Go on ahead, Durotan awaits, I must catch my breath.
It is up to you, champion. I will stay here and help with the wounded slaves you rescued.
It seems the elements of Draenor do not respond to me as they do on Azeroth.
You'd better hurry! Here they come!
JABU!
I was taught by the best, Dregthar.
He'd be pleased to hear you say that.
I do, I saw that my mate remained behind to care for our little ones.

LOCKTAROGA!

He has become one with the fury, their spirits are now merged.
You mentioned the Frostwolf chieftain.
Dura-tan.
This terrain is ideal for a stronghold.
The very best.
Gazlow here oversaw the construction of Orgrimmar.
I can feel it. This land speaks to me, but in a language I do not yet understand.
The spirits will never abandon you, Drak'thahr. This I can promise.
The Thunderlords retreat! They are making their way through Thunder Pass to the Iron Horde.
What is this?
Durotan, your brother has already rushed ahead.
Thank you, Chieftain. We will establish a foothold immediately.
Together we will bring justice to Garrosh and the Warsong Clan.
The Burning Blade is an honorable clan, but they have chosen the wrong side in this conflict.
We must defeat the ogres, the burning blade, and the orcs at Lokrath. Then we'll be ready to move on Grommashar.
Get lost!
No. No more, Keros. Just you and me.
I challenge you to Makkora!
Scare us!
No. No more, Garrosh. Just you and me.
I challenge you to Makkora!
Stay alive, champion.
The elements will grant us time for Azeroth!
Fury of Earth, grant me your strength!
I... I grow weary. The elements are barely a whisper.

I will not stand by and watch our heroes be destroyed.
Fury of Storms, hear my plea!
I will not be able to defend the front for much longer. My power here is greatly diminished. The champion must succeed or Azeroth will fall.
GOOD LUCK

Hold strong, everyone. Here they come.
Kandar, get us out of here!
Fury of Earth, grant these heroes your protection!
FURY OF FIRE! Ignite our fists and weapons!
Fury of Wind, honor these soldiers with your presence.
Fury of water, heal our injured.
Our spirit will triumph.
For the Horde!
Fight with honor.
We will not be broken.
Run our enemies into the ground.
This is a savage land.
Moktarogar, champion.
The Horde has important work here.
This land is nothing like Azeroth.
Loctar, Commander!
Seriously, are we gonna do this?

The Doom Hammer

Aronark is familiar with the darkest depths of Azeroth's oceans. He will know how best to proceed.
I've got this one, Shaiman. Help the others!
Shaiman, I have an urgent message.
Yes, we must strike back, but how?
Look out!
Your master has not won yet.
Spirits, hear my call!
GRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRLE
They will come for us.
I remember the night Orgrim fell, run through by a knight's lance during the liberation of the last orc internment camp. As he bled out onto the fields of Arathi, he bestowed the Doomhammer to me.
We must fight together, or we will perish alone.
We must not lose hope.
Never give in.
Fight on!
This is our darkest hour.
The Legion will stop at nothing.
What news?
I always knew this day would come.
The Doom Hammer is somewhere in these chambers. I can feel it.
Scout the chambers ahead. I will stay nearby.
All the more reason to get to the Doomhammer first.
Doomhammer. It felt like dead weight in my hands. The elements were silent. It has been this way since I used it to slay Garrosh.
We've got to keep moving. Get Zune as close.
The Doomhammer! Get the Doomhammer! Prove your power as a shaman!
The whole of Azeroth will rise against you, demon!
the very earth beneath your feet, and the skies above your head will lash out against your damned crusade!
The Doomhammer chose you, Shaiman. Already you wield it with a power that I never tapped into.
I must go my own way. I have a great deal of thinking to do. Agra will be at the maelstrom shortly. Listen to her counsel. She has taught me so much.
Go back to the earthen ring, bring them together, turn their might against a legion. This is your time.
The Doomhammer is not merely a weapon, it is a symbol, a symbol of hope, of power, proof that an individual can change the world.
The Doomhammer could be anywhere. We'll have to split up.
I will speak with the shaman at the temple of earth.
Shriman, you must seek out the stone mother, but be cautious. She is quick to anger.
We should meet back up at Therazane's throne once we know more. Good luck to both of you.
The shaman at the temple of earth know nothing.
Rhaegar has a plan. Speak with him. He's good to have at your back in a fight.
FODRING!
The magma erupts! Watch yourselves!
He breathes that foul breath again. Look out!
There are... too many of them!
It looks like our reinforcements have arrived.
Hmm, there's only one way out of this one, old friend.
Back to the nether!
You
LUTAROGAR!

Yes, they must anchor it to this world.
FOCUS ON THE COMMANDER!
FELFIRE RAINS FROM THE SKY! LOOK OUT!
It is good to fight with you again, Warchief.
There's only one way to the tomb. Are you ready?
They're expanding faster than we've seen before!
What?
THEY'RE ALIVE!
those crystals again. If we can get close to them, we can bring this thing down!
BREAK THE CRYSTALS!
This invasion is unlike any I have ever witnessed, and I don't think we've seen the last of their surprises.
We will find him. Horde forces, keep your eyes open for survivors. Rescue as many as you are able.

Spirits of Earth, aid me!
Varok Saurfinn!
SON OF KORUK
Supreme Commander of the Might of Kalimdor.
High Overlord of the Horde!

Saurfang inspired all of us to strive for true honor, and his legacy will live on in our deeds.
You have earned your warrior's death, old friend.
Now greet your son with honor and glory.
Saurfang and I spoke much of honor in the Horde, of our path forward from this crossroads.
I never thought we would have to walk it without him. It falls to us to decide what the Horde will become."
Azeroth needs our strength now more than ever. Grieve for Saurfang and make ready to defend the world he died for."

GO!

PAIN!

Jaina

This is what makes us strong. All of us, building a new future, together."

It was your cleverness and ingenuity that built the walls of Orgrimmar. I can't think of anyone I would trust more to take over as leader."
Can you be sure that none of the goblins here are still being funded by Galliwicks?

The blood of the old god is our only salvation.

WE MUST OBEY NAZAF!
None can overcome his might!

something has changed. Pure noble souls are being held captive here as well. They cry out in torment."

Find the cave on the other side of the chasm, our allies will protect you there.
Your bonds are broken. Hurry, before the guards return!

For Azeroth!

I believe I have, in a place very far from here.

Dragora, it is good to hold it once again.

Margrave. A title that comes with authority and expectations. Much like Warchief.

Bane and I will aid them. We won't let the Jailer claim the Arbiter's sigil.

as a sign that he hasn't been fully dominated by the Jailer's power.

Yield Sylvanas!
For sourfang! For the horde!
Spirits, grant me aid!
I am in your debt, Highlord.
My defenses falter!
With me, champions, Jaina needs our strength.

The spirits stand with us!
BLOOD AND THUNDER!

The Jailer will unleash all his fury upon us. We must not falter.
Fight to save our world!

Look out!

Up there, above us!

Vol'jin, it's good to see you, brother.

Vol'jin I chose Garrosh because he has the strength to lead our people in these trying times.

The Horde cries for a hero of old. An orc of true blood that will bow to no human and bear no betrayal. A warrior that will make our people proud again. Garrosh can be that hero.

I did not make this decision lightly, Vol'jin. I know our alliances will suffer for it. I know the Horde will be irreversibly changed, but I made this choice with confidence that Garrosh is exactly what the Horde needs.
I'm trusting you and the other leaders not to let this divide our people. You are stronger than that.
Thrum car, old friend.
I will see you up top. Thank you again for my freedom.

Power of the Ocean! Heed my call!

For now, you will remain the trade prince of the Bilgewater Cartel.
I will send a representative from amongst your people to the new Warchief Garrosh Hillscream in Orgrimmar.

Citizen of Azeroth, behold.

Fail. I have failed this world. The elements will not speak to me. The earthen dream has lost faith in my leadership. My weakness is delivered Azeroth into oblivion.
Oblivion. Nothing. But Oblivion.
I have failed the Horde, as Warchief. Garrosh will lead it to ruin. My people, to ruin. Care, my brother? Why did I not listen?
Why did I not listen?
I know your faith, Agra. Oh my heart, can't you see? I am nothing. Selfish at all I've done, accomplished, all for the sake of pride alone. I am unworthy of you.
Agra, it is you.
Agra, I... I can't hold on, I can't... AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA
We are patient.
We are patient.
We are patient.
Now, awaken!
Agra I heard your voice calling me back. Where are we?
Agra! Agra! I can't hear! I can't hear!
In the face of this cataclysm, I've seen how truly fleeting our lives can be. And I, for one, will not waste another second of mine.
Though I was not born on Draenor, I have always tried to honor the traditions of our ancestors.
I stand before you, Goel, son of Durotan, son of Garad. And if you would have me, I would be your life mate.
For so long as I live, I will stand at your side, as you have stood at mine."
My parents. Murdered before I could know them. Betrayed. Gul'dan. If I must burn my way across the afterlife, I will find you in whatever hell you've hidden. I will have my revenge. Do you hear me?
Raised as a slave, to kill for human amusement, death was too good for Blackmore. Anyone who would enslave another deserves worse than death. All are guilty. All must pay!
King Varian. You wish to make war on my people? You shall have your war, human. You will see the fury of the Horde rage through your cities. You will see your throne split in two. This I swear.
Garrosh, Garrosh, Kaeron was my brother!
I am alive.

Fandral sought to use that weakness against me, but what he and his twilight masters never understood is that the elements do not exist to rage and war. They exist to bring harmony within the world and within us. I have seen the truth, and my chains have been broken.
Now, I am all that I once was, and more.

The Twilight's Hammer!
I do not fear death.
AHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH
